description: Delete one saved scenario file of the simulation workspace this credential is connected to, by its id from list_saved_simulation_scenarios. Only the saved file goes: runs already made from it, and what they recorded, are kept. It cannot be undone, so name the scenario to the user and get their go-ahead first. Refused on any account that is not a simulation workspace (NOT_A_SIMULATION_WORKSPACE); an unknown id is NOT_FOUND.

savedScenarioId.description: The saved scenario's id, from list_saved_simulation_scenarios.

name: delete_saved_simulation_scenario
title: Delete Saved Simulation Scenario
